description:
Create a 25 kW grid-connected photovoltaic system in the eQUEST model for the 4StoreyBuilding. 

Starting from the 'Project & Site' or 'Electric Generation' module in Detailed Edit Mode:
1. Create a new PV Generator object.
2. Configure it with the following parameters:
   - Capacity: 25.0 kW
   - Fixed Tilt: 20 degrees
   - Azimuth: 180 degrees (South)
   - Efficiency (Effective/Operating): 0.18
3. Run the full annual DOE-2.2 simulation.
4. Save the project.

The simulation results must reflect the generated electricity. The project is located at C:\Users\Docker\Documents\eQUEST 3-65 Projects\4StoreyBuilding\4StoreyBuilding.inp.
